delete_step_1: 1. In-App: Open The Realty Bazaar app > Profile > Account Actions > Delete Account.
delete_step_2: 2. Web / Request Form: Fill out the form below with your registered Email or Phone number.

data_retention_desc: When you delete your account, personal data such as your name, contact details, authentication credentials, and social media tokens are immediately disconnected and scheduled for complete purge. Non-personal operational records (e.g. past property inquiry logs and compliance records) are retained securely for a maximum retention period of 30 days for fraud prevention and statutory regulatory obligations.

pp_section_1_content: We collect personal information such as your name, email, phone number, and brokerage details when you register and use our platform.
pp_section_2_content: Your data is used to provide CRM services, automate social media marketing, process video requests, and improve app functionality.
pp_section_3_content: We do not sell your personal data. We only share information with Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and payment gateways to deliver our core services.
pp_section_4_content: We implement 256-bit encryption and industry-standard security protocols to keep your information safe and confidential.
pp_section_5_content: You can request account deactivation or full data deletion anytime directly from the account settings in the application.
pp_section_6_content: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact our support team at support@therealtybazaar.com.

tos_section_2_content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.
tos_section_3_content: You agree not to publish fraudulent property listings, misuse social media automation tools, or violate applicable real estate regulations.
tos_section_4_content: Subscription fees are billed according to your selected plan. All payments processed via authorized gateways are non-refundable once activated.
tos_section_5_content: The Realty Bazaar is not liable for indirect damages, service interruptions, or lead generation variations resulting from third-party social platforms.
tos_section_6_content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that breach these terms. These terms are governed by the laws of India.
